senses.sense_definition: Simple in design, character, or appearance; without decoration, pattern, or luxury.

examples.text: She decided to wear a <w>plain</w> white dress to the summer party.

senses.sense_definition: Easy to see, hear, or understand; clear to the mind.

examples.text: It was <w>plain</w> to everyone in the room that he was very nervous.

target_lang_translations.it: Era <w>evidente</w> a tutti nella stanza che fosse molto nervoso.
target_lang_translations.cs: Všem v místnosti bylo <w>jasné</w>, že je velmi nervózní.

target_lang_translations.de: Bitte schreiben Sie die Anleitung in <w>einfachem</w> Englisch, damit jeder sie verstehen kann.

senses.sense_definition: Used to emphasize that something is bad, foolish, or extreme; total or absolute.

examples.text: It is just <w>plain</w> wrong to treat people with such disrespect.

target_lang_translations.ru: Относиться к людям с таким неуважением — просто <w>совершенно</w> неправильно.
target_lang_translations.nl: Het is <w>gewoonweg</w> verkeerd om mensen met zoveel disrespect te behandelen.

target_lang_translations.fr: Laisse-moi être <w>franc</w> avec toi : je ne suis pas du tout d'accord avec ton projet.

senses.sense_definition: Used to emphasize an adjective or verb, meaning 'simply' or 'completely'.
